title: Restarting antithrombotics after ICH
keyNumbers: Nonvalvular AF, decision made to restart: Start about 7–8 weeks after ICH, adjusted to the patient
question: Whether and when to resume antiplatelets or anticoagulants after spontaneous ICH
population: Survivors of spontaneous ICH with a prior antithrombotic indication

rules.recommendation: Early resumption of anticoagulation is reasonable
Resuming antiplatelet therapy may be reasonable, weighing benefit and risk
Resuming anticoagulation may be considered to prevent thromboembolism and reduce mortality
evidenceNote: ESO-EANS 2025 PICO 6.2: no evidence-based recommendation (net benefit uncertain; low quality); expert consensus (14/15): DOAC may be considered after individual risk–benefit review

rules.condition: Nonvalvular AF, decision made to restart
rules.recommendation: Start about 7–8 weeks after ICH, adjusted to the patient

rules.condition: Nonvalvular AF, judged ineligible for anticoagulation
rules.recommendation: Left atrial appendage closure may be considered
evidenceNote: ESO-EANS 2025 PICO 6.3 expert consensus (15/15): e.g., imaging or pathological evidence of CAA

pearls: Recurrence risk: prior lobar ICH HR 4.8; lobar microbleeds HR 1.88 (1), 2.93 (2–4), 4.12 (>4); disseminated cortical siderosis HR 4.69 (AHA ICH 2022 §9.1.1)

ESO-EANS 2025: OAC may not benefit — CAA-unrelated ICH with ≥10 microbleeds; CAA-related ICH with superficial siderosis or non-aneurysmal cSAH, or ≥5 lobar microbleeds; uncontrolled hypertension; chronic alcohol abuse (ungraded)

PRESTIGE-AF (DOAC vs no OAC, n=319, enrolled 14 d–12 mo after ICH, median 49 d): ischemic stroke 0.83 vs 8.60/100 pt-yr (HR 0.05); all ICH 5.00 vs 0.82/100 pt-yr, recurrent-ICH non-inferiority not met (HR 10.89); NNT 13/yr, NNH 24/yr

ENRICH-AF (presented ESC 2026, unpublished; edoxaban vs no OAC, n=948, median 74 d after intracranial hemorrhage incl. SDH/cSAH): stroke/SE 11.8% vs 12.8% (HR 0.88, NS); ischemic stroke HR 0.57, hemorrhagic stroke HR 2.99; ISTH major bleeding 11.6% vs 5.2% (HR 2.23)

Lobar ICH or cSAH: ENRICH-AF stopped enrolling them (2023) for excess recurrent intracranial hemorrhage on edoxaban: 7.4 vs 3.2/100 pt-yr (non-lobar ICH 2.4 vs 1.0). PRESTIGE-AF (post hoc) found no location effect
